'''Grimlock Saves the Day''' is a [[Spotlight Mission]] (promoted as a [[Chrono-Vector]]) featuring [[Grimlock]], [[Wheeljack]] and [[Optimus Prime]] that runs from June 6 to the 20th.

== Forum Description ==
{{Quotes|Oh no Commander...

Wheeljack has been experimenting on a device that could harness the many new and strange energies on New Quintessa. His new, and untested, Chrono-Vector Device could POTENTIALLY allow the user to travel along a time-bridge. Unfortunately the first unexpected test-run is manned by Grimlock, a dinobot on a mission.

Can Wheeljack and Optimus Prime stop the mighty Grimlock from unravelling the past? Only TIME will tell!}}

== Changes/Rewards ==
[[File:We_need_more_of_these.png|center|500px]]
== Chapter 1: "The War of Cybertron" ==
===Mission 1: "What Is It Good For?" ===
==== Part 1 ====
*[[Wheeljack]]: ''Hey [[Optimus Prime|Optimus]]? There's a slightly... massive problem we need to address.''
*Optimus Prime: ''What is the quandry, Wheeljack?''
*Wheeljack: ''Well it's not great, so I'm going to attempt to power through it in one sentence...''
*''[[Grimlock]] took a [[Chrono-Vector]] device I was working on and used an [[Energon]] burst to time-travel so he can alter the outcome of the'' [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Great_War_(G1) ''Cybertronian War].''
*Optimus Prime: ''That could cause our timeline to unravel, could it not?''
*Wheeljack: ''Haven't really tested that far ahead. I'm assuming it'd result in something ranging from unnoticed to fully apocalyptic.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Sounds like we're going to have to follow him.''

==== Part 2 ====
*Wheeljack: ''So it's probably best if no one remembers doubles of us appearing in the war.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Agreed. If we only had a way to erase our errant appearance from their memories.''
*Wheeljack: ''Yep. Memory-Jammer! I crafted one ages ago and brought it with us.''
*Optimus Prime: ''That appears to be a rather large and elaborate magnet. Does it work?''
*Wheeljack: ''Don't you remember? Then it definitely works.''
*Optimus Prime: ''...''
*''We should get moving.''

==== Part 3 ====
*Wheeljack: ''Powering up spare Chrono-Vector device. I got a lock on Grimlock's location. Prep for jump and strap down your loose parts.''
*[[Hound]]: ''I don't think you should be doin' that fellas. Way I figure it, Grimlock has a point.''
*Optimus Prime: ''He told you about his plan? We move forward Hound, we can not risk changes to our past.''
*Hound: ''You ain't got a right to say that Prime. Maybe it changes for the better! You think of that?''
*Optimus Prime: ''I think of nothing but what is best for us all, and unforeseeable ripples in time serve nothing but chaos.''
*Hound: ''All I have to do is stop you from making that jump and we can all see those ripples come in together.''
*Optimus Prime: ''What happens next, happens to ensure the timeline. I assure you this is not personal.''

===Mission 2: "Absolutely Nothing"===
==== Part 1 ====
*Optimus Prime: ''The transfer here was deeply unsettling.''
*Wheeljack: ''Count your digits and limbs. I'm almost certain all of us made it across the jump.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Is this fully untested technology Wheeljack?''
*Wheeljack: ''Of course not, I watched Grimlock do it and recorded notes as it happened. ''That's'' at least one test.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Cybertron... It is good to be back, even under such dire circumstances.''
*Wheeljack: ''I'm trying not to think about it too much. We have work to do.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Agreed. We have a grave task ahead of us.''

==== Part 2 ====
*[[Ultra Magnus]]: ''Optimus! Why are you attacking Autobot troops?!''
*Optimus Prime: ''It is too complicated to explain Ultra Magnus. It is a matter of utmost importance that we are not taking lightly.''
*Wheeljack: ''We're preventing an errant time-loop collapse. It mostly makes sense from our end.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''There's something faulty in both your circuits. I'll not sacrifice the safety of my friends to your ramblings.''
*Optimus Prime: ''I'm no stranger to sacrifice. I burst with pride to see you stand up to adversity, but I must complete our mission.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''It pains me to say this Prime but...'' '''''stop now or be shut down.'''''
*Wheeljack: ''Don't worry, you'll never recall this moral struggle. Commander, let's get moving.''

==== Part 3 ====
*Grimlock: {{RedText|ME GRIMLOCK SAVE DAY! WHY YOU FOLLOW HERE?!}}
*Optimus Prime: ''Grimlock, I understand your noble intent. Truly. But this is too large a change to the past.''
*Wheeljack: ''You make too big a splash old friend. It could destroy things. You get that right?''
*Grimlock: ''You want... Grimlock to'' lose?
*Optimus Prime: ''A win here could mean larger loses'' [sic; "''losses''"] ''elsewhere. What if it means we never go to Earth and leave it exposed to attack?''
*Grimlock: {{RedText|ME GRIMLOCK NEVER EXPOSED! ME BEST THERE IS! ME KING!}}
*Wheeljack: ''We tried to talk this out bud, but you may not remember that later.''

== Map Layouts ==
''The map layouts are the same throughout all the difficulties.''

*''Skip to Mission 1: [[#{{{2|1:1 - Left Lane}}}|left lane]] | [[#{{{2|1:2 - Right Lane}}}|right lane]] 
*''Skip to Mission 2: [[#{{{2|2:1 - Left Lane}}}|left lane]] | [[#{{{2|2:2 - Right Lane}}}|right lane]]''

=== Mission 1 ===
==== 1:1 - Left Lane ====
''[[Utility Module|Mods]] unique to this lane: '''Ranged Damage'''. Prime Boost is added from Medium onwards''
* Sideswipe
* Bumblebee (DOTM)

==== 1:2 - Right Lane ====
''[[Utility Module|Mods]] unique to this lane: '''Power Flow'''. Prime Boost is added from Medium onwards''
* Ratchet
* Ironhide

==== Coming in from both lanes ====
''Combines both '''Power Flow''' and '''Ranged Damage''', and also unlocks Special 3''
* Hound (boss)

=== Mission 2 ===
==== 2:1 - Left Lane ====
''[[Utility Module|Mods]] unique to this lane: '''Physical Resistance'''. Prime Boost is added from Medium onwards''
* Arcee
* '''''Wheeljack'''''
* Prowl

==== 2:1 - Right Lane ====
''[[Utility Module|Mods]] unique to this lane: '''Debuff Duration'''. Prime Boost is added from Medium onwards''
* Blaster
* Windblade
* Drift

==== Coming in from both lanes ====
* Ultra Magnus (miniboss) ('''Evade Melee''')
* Grimlock (boss) (Combines '''Physical Resistance''' and '''Debuff Duration''' and adds Special 3)
